architectural_reading: GAP identifies the BT170 projective compiler image with the degree-45 primitive group O(5,3), then pulls back the overgroup O(5,3):C2 to the same quotient labels. The pulled-back overgroup preserves the 27 GQ(4,2) lines, has order 51840, point stabilizer 1152, line stabilizer 1920, and is generated by the compiler image plus one explicit order-2 outer involution. This closes the finite W(E6) stabilizer cascade for the 45-point quotient.
boundary: The outer involution is an explicit GAP primitive-library witness. The intrinsic W(3,3) construction of the same involution remains the next target, likely through the Q8/octonion/J3(O) feedback loop.
